summary.text: Andrew Eye is the Democratic candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 144, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Andrew Eye ran in the November 5, 2024 general election for Missouri House District 144, where incumbent Tony Harbison defeated him.
In 2026, Eye advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4 and faces Republican Chris Dinkins, who defeated Harbison in the Republican primary.
